blocks.text: The experiencer of the three is the lord of heroes.
blocks.directed: The experiencer of the three is the lord of heroes.

blocks.text: Congratulations, You’re Now the Lord of the Three Worlds.
blocks.directed: Congratulations, You’re Now the Lord of the Three Worlds.

blocks.text: We’ve now moved through waking, dreaming and deep sleep.
blocks.directed: We’ve now moved through waking, dreaming and deep sleep.

blocks.text: And Vasugupta asks an obvious question.
blocks.directed: And Vasugupta asks an obvious question.

blocks.text: What is the condition of someone who has realised turya throughout these three states?
blocks.directed: What is the condition of someone who has realised turya throughout these three states?

blocks.text: The word vīra means hero, but in the tantric context it can also relate to the powers of the senses.
blocks.directed: The word vīra means hero, but in the tantric context it can also relate to the powers of the senses.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja interprets the realised yogi as sovereign over these powers, enjoying the conscious reality underlying the three conditions.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja interprets the realised yogi as sovereign over these powers, enjoying the conscious reality underlying the three conditions.

blocks.text: Because such a yogi no longer fundamentally mistakes the passing forms of experience for separate, self-existing authorities.
blocks.directed: Because such a yogi no longer fundamentally mistakes the passing forms of experience for separate, self-existing authorities.

blocks.text: The underlying conscious reality is not diminished by any of them.
blocks.directed: The underlying conscious reality is not diminished by any of them.

blocks.text: There is an enormous philosophical difference between being absorbed into an experience and recognising the source through which it appears.
blocks.directed: There is an enormous philosophical difference between being absorbed into an experience and recognising the source through which it appears.

blocks.text: An ordinary person becomes caught up in the drama.
blocks.directed: An ordinary person becomes caught up in the drama.

blocks.text: The realised person can participate without losing the recognition of their deeper nature.
blocks.directed: The realised person can participate without losing the recognition of their deeper nature.

blocks.text: And notice that the text says bhoktā — experiencer or enjoyer.
blocks.directed: And notice that the text says bhoktā — experiencer or enjoyer.

blocks.text: Not a cosmic hermit refusing all manifestation.
blocks.directed: Not a cosmic hermit refusing all manifestation.

blocks.text: The hero doesn’t necessarily stop watching the performance.
blocks.directed: The hero doesn’t necessarily stop watching the performance.

blocks.text: The hero understands the nature of the theatre.
blocks.directed: The hero understands the nature of the theatre.
